---
title: "Labs"
---

Labs referenced by the Sandcastle course. Course-scoped labs live
under `courses/sandcastle/labs/`; reusable labs shared with other
courses live under the repository-root [`labs/`](../../../labs/index.html)
directory.

## Referenced labs

There is no runnable Sandcastle lab yet.

::: {.callout-warning title="Scaffold — no runnable Sandcastle lab yet"}
This wave of the Sandcastle course delivers substantive Part 1
**instruction** but does not yet include a runnable Sandcastle lab.
The Part 1 lesson's [Lab page](../part-1/01-inside-a-sandcastle/lab.qmd)
is a structured paper walkthrough, not an executable lab, and it is
labelled as such. A reusable
`labs/hello-world-pico-sandcastle/` (or equivalently named) runnable
lab is planned for a later curriculum-verification wave.
:::

## Related reusable labs

While no Sandcastle-specific lab exists yet, these existing reusable
labs are useful context — they define the **artifact** a future
Sandcastle lab will produce and the **cluster** it may hand off to:

- [Hello Pico](../../../labs/hello-pico/) — produces the
  `hello-world-pico` greeting artifact from the [Pico course](../../pico/index.html).
  This is the artifact a future Sandcastle lab will construct.
- [Hello Pico on Kubernetes](../../../labs/hello-pico-on-kubernetes/)
  — composes `hello-world-pico` onto a local minikube cluster with
  Crossplane. A future Sandcastle lab may hand its output to this
  lab's Composition as its downstream reconciliation target.

## Authoring course-scoped labs

Course-scoped labs live in this directory and follow the shared lab
template. Reuse a repository-root lab when the same lab is useful for
more than one course.
